content: Recommendation diversity. As defined in BIBREF18 , we calculate recommendation diversity as the average dissimilarity of all pairs of tags in the list of recommended tags. Thus, given a distance function INLINEFORM0 that corresponds to the dissimilarity between two tags INLINEFORM1 and INLINEFORM2 in the list of recommended tags, INLINEFORM3 is given as the average dissimilarity of all pairs of tags: DISPLAYFORM0
